articles.title: Black Sea Strikes Are Making It Harder to Get Wheat
articles.summary: The Black Sea is the most dangerous it has been since the war in Ukraine began. Since July, there have been more than 210 attacks on ships, and wheat exports from Russia and Ukraine are down about 60 percent.

articles.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Cut Ties as Fighting Grows in the North
articles.summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea have cut diplomatic ties after more than 50 people were killed in new fighting in northern Ethiopia. Ethiopia ordered 10 Eritrean diplomats to leave within 48 hours, and Eritrea responded by ending relations.

articles.title: Putin Warns the West About a Small Russian Territory Called Kaliningrad
articles.summary: Russia's leader, Vladimir Putin, warned NATO not to threaten Kaliningrad — a small Russian area squeezed between Poland and Lithuania. He said Russia would use every weapon it has, including nuclear ones, to defend it. NATO says it is a defensive alliance.
